01_canon: Wide panoramic establishing background of the Juchipila river canyon on a golden morning: a wide pale sandy riverbed with a shallow teal river winding through sand banks, big riverside ahuehuete trees, small terraced corn fields on the lower slopes, tall reddish canyon mountains with layered ridges fading into blue haze, big sky with soft painted clouds. Strong depth: foreground sand ripples and rocks, midground river and trees, background mountains. Open empty sandy ground across the lower third. No people, no animals.
02_senorio: Wide background of a Caxcan village on a river terrace in the Juchipila canyon, year 1540: small adobe and stone houses with thatched palm roofs, a low stepped stone platform with a small shrine on top, a milpa of corn with beans and squash, clay pots and a grinding stone by a doorway, thin smoke rising from cooking fires, the teal river and sand banks behind, reddish mountains in the distance. Strong depth with foreground plants. Open empty packed-earth ground across the lower third. No people, no animals.
03_encomienda: Wide background of the same canyon valley under a cold grey-blue overcast sky: a rough Spanish encomienda house of adobe with a red clay tile roof and a heavy wooden door, a tall wooden cross beside it, a wooden fence corral, a pile of maize sacks and baskets stacked as tribute under a shed, a dirt path in the foreground, Caxcan hills and reddish mountains behind. Strong depth. Open empty dirt ground across the lower third. No people, no animals.
04_noche: Wide background of the same canyon valley at night: deep violet-blue sky with stars and a pale moon, many bonfires burning on the tops of the hills and ridges with warm orange glow and smoke, the Spanish adobe house with red tile roof in the midground lit by a single torch, dark sand path in the foreground with long blue shadows. Dramatic but readable. Open empty ground across the lower third. No people, no animals.
05_penol: Wide background at a blood-red dusk: a huge steep flat-topped rocky mountain fortress rising above the Juchipila canyon, its cliffs catching the last red light, thin smoke columns rising from its summit, dark layered ridges in the foreground and a winding river far below. Ominous and epic. No people, no animals.
06_petacatl_hoja: Character model sheet on a plain flat pure white background: Petacatl, a Caxcan lord of about forty, brown skin, long black hair tied with a red cord, a headdress of a few long green and red feathers, white cotton cape with an ochre geometric border knotted at the shoulder, loincloth, leather sandals, jade bead necklace, holding a tall wooden staff. The SAME man drawn 5 times, full body, evenly spaced in one row with generous empty white space between them, never touching or overlapping: front view standing calm; three-quarter view speaking with an open hand; pointing forward with arm fully extended; raising the staff high in anger; arms crossed, proud. No ground, no cast shadows.
07_petacatl_camina: Animation sprite sheet on a plain flat pure white background: walk cycle of Petacatl, a Caxcan lord with long black hair tied with a red cord, green and red feathers, white cotton cape with ochre geometric border, loincloth, sandals, wooden staff. The SAME character drawn 8 times in a single horizontal row, strict side view facing right, full body, same size and same height, evenly spaced and not touching, each drawing a consecutive phase of one walking step (contact, down, passing, up, for each leg). No ground, no cast shadows.
08_caxcanes_hoja: Character sheet on a plain flat pure white background: 6 different Caxcan villagers of the Juchipila canyon in 1540, full body, evenly spaced in one row with generous empty white space, never touching or overlapping: an old farmer with a wooden digging stick; a woman carrying a clay water pot on her head; a small child holding a corn cob; a young warrior with a bow and a quiver of arrows; a warrior with an obsidian-edged wooden club and a round feathered shield; an elder woman grinding corn on a stone. Simple white cotton clothes with ochre and red details. No ground, no cast shadows.
